evidence: The crystallinity of the film was identified using an X-ray diffraction (XRD, Rigaku D/MAX 2500/PC). The surface was checked by atomic force microscopy (AFM). X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS, Thermo Scientific-Theta Probe) was used to analyze the chemical binding of the Y2O3 films. The Auger electron spectroscopy (AES) system (PHI 700Xi) was used to analyze the depth profile of the composition. The thickness and refractive index of the ALD-Y2O3 film on the Si substrate were measured using TEM (JEOL JEM-2010) and spectroscopic ellipsometry (Horiba UVISEL).
